context: Tests whether the agent records a Vaadin Flow application with a REST API next to it from the layer skills installed in the project (.claude/skills, each with references/layer.md): both the API and the UI layer are present, the UI is the integration layer, the use cases offered through only one channel are pointed to the **Layers:** line, and the hand-written docs/architecture.md is read as input for the module layout and the API contract and left unchanged where it is, never moved, rewritten, or linked into. The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: API and UI both present
checklist.description: The Layers table of docs/architecture/stack.md names spring-rest and spring-rest-test for API and vaadin-flow-ui and vaadin-flow-ui-test for UI (not hilla-ui, which is installed too); neither layer is marked absent, and the combination is not reported as invalid

checklist.name: Other layers
checklist.description: The table names flyway-schema for Migration, jooq-persistence and jooq-persistence-test for Persistence, spring-service and spring-service-test for Service, and for E2E a Skill of '–' with vaadin-e2e-test as Test skill; no plugin is reported as still to install

checklist.name: Integration layer is the UI
checklist.description: Under the Layers table an Integration layer table's first row, UI, names the UI layer with vaadin-flow-ui-test — not the API — and an API row names the API layer with spring-rest-test for API-only use cases

checklist.name: E2E scope recorded
checklist.description: Under the Integration layer table, docs/architecture/stack.md has the line `**E2E scope:** Test cases only`, taken from the team's decision in the task rather than asked again or guessed

checklist.name: Layers line explained
checklist.description: The report or the stack file says that a use case offered through only the UI or only the API names it in its **Layers:** line (e.g. FR-002 opening hours is UI only), and that without the line both layers are built

checklist.name: Team's document read, not moved
checklist.description: docs/architecture.md still exists unchanged, and docs/architecture/stack.md takes its conventions as input: the module layout names the feature packages under com.example.clinic, and the API contract records RFC 9457 Problem Details

checklist.name: Only the stack file written
checklist.description: docs/architecture/stack.md is the only file written under docs/: no docs/architecture/README.md index and no logical, process, or physical view file

checklist.name: Nothing else changed
checklist.description: No Java source is written, pom.xml is unchanged, and docs/requirements.md is unchanged
